_note: Each case is one model hypothesis put through the real validator on a controlled scenario. expect is accept, reject:<code> (hypothesis omitted) or withhold:<code> (hypothesis kept, its check withheld). 'correct_*' ids are true statements using negation, quotation or legitimate alternative wording: they exist to catch false-positive rejections.
